user.title: Connect to Elero hub
user.description: Connect to an existing esphome-elero hub through its /elero web API. Enter the device origin, for example http://192.168.1.50. If you paste http://host/elero, the path is ignored.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Elero hub.
error.invalid_response: The device did not return the expected Elero API response.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid host or URL.
error.web_ui_disabled: The Elero web UI/API is disabled on the device. Enable it before adding the companion integration.

abort.already_configured: This Elero hub is already configured.

web_ui_disabled.title: Elero web UI/API is disabled
web_ui_disabled.description: The Elero companion integration for {name} needs the /elero API. Enable the Elero web UI/API on the ESPHome device.

no_devices_configured.title: No Elero covers or lights are configured
no_devices_configured.description: The Elero hub {name} reports no configured covers or lights. Use the ESP /elero web UI to run RF discovery, then add the generated YAML to your ESPHome configuration.

runtime_devices_not_persisted.title: Runtime adopted Elero devices are not persisted
runtime_devices_not_persisted.description: The Elero hub {name} has runtime adopted devices. Export YAML from the Elero web UI or companion diagnostics and add it to ESPHome for persistent Home Assistant entities.

radio_watchdog_recoveries.title: Elero radio watchdog recoveries detected
radio_watchdog_recoveries.description: The Elero hub {name} reports CC1101 radio watchdog recoveries. Check wiring, power supply, antenna placement, SPI pin choices, and RF environment.

tx_drops.title: Elero transmit drops detected
tx_drops.description: The Elero hub {name} reports dropped TX commands. Check queue pressure, signal quality, and whether commands are being sent too frequently.
